analysis.reason:
2거래일 연속 6% 이상 급등 후 숨 고르기 구간 진입.
RSI 43.6으로 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 히스토그램은 음전환 후 악화 지속.
주봉 ADX 26.8로 뚜렷한 추세 유지하나, 일봉상 단기 과열 경계 필요.
analysis.reasonEn:
Following two consecutive days of over 6% gains, the price has entered a consolidation phase.
RSI is hovering around 43.6 in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram has turned negative and continues to worsen.
The weekly ADX at 26.8 indicates a persistent trend, but caution is warranted for short-term overheating on the daily chart.

Weekly ADX at 26.8 maintains trend, but caution is advised for short-term overheating on the daily chart.
